# SysEagles Shop

> Build and manage an online shop with SysEagles Shop: product catalogs, checkout, orders, delivery settings and inventory integrations for store owners.

## Public resources

- [Product information](https://shop.syseagles.com/about.md): Product features and access requirements.
- [Sitemap](https://shop.syseagles.com/sitemap.xml): Curated public URLs only.
- [Public metadata API](https://shop.syseagles.com/openapi.json): Read-only product information.
- [Agent guide](https://shop.syseagles.com/agent-guide.md): Public access boundaries.

## Privacy

Signed-in records, uploads, accounts, mailboxes, assessments and business transactions are private. Public discoverability does not authorize account access.
